name: Shandong Head Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shandong Head Group Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of cellulose ether. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose, methyl cellulose, hydroxyethyl cellulose, methyl hydroxyethyl cellulose, ethyl cellulose, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, and low-substituted hydroxypropyl cellulose. These versatile products find widespread application across various sectors, including dry mixed mortar, pharmaceuticals, food, PVC resins, cosmetics, and oil exploration. The company extends its market reach beyond China, exporting its goods to international territories such as the United States, Europe, Africa, and Australia. Established in 1992 and headquartered in Zibo, People's Republic of China, the company was initially known as Shandong Head Co.,Ltd. before officially adopting its current name, Shandong Head Group Co.,Ltd., in January 2022.
